label: Pi
description: Pi coding agent CLI (pi, v0.85.x). One harness over the Architect's OpenAI, OpenCode Go, CommandCode and Kimi Coding subscriptions. Skills are injected as explicit --skill paths under --no-skills; MCP is delegated to the installed pi-mcp-adapter extension through a project-scoped --mcp-config file in exclusive config mode, with server environment left in the provider process (never serialized into the generated config).

permissions.interactive_auto_approve_justification: --approve is Pi's one-run project-trust grant. It is what keeps an interactive Fixer TUI from blocking on the non-interactive-incompatible trust prompt for a repository that carries project-local resources (this repo ships .agents/skills). Pi has no separate tool-approval flag: its built-in tools always run with the user's own permissions.
permissions.headless_auto_approve_justification: Headless -p runs never show a trust prompt, so --no-approve is passed deliberately: it makes project-local settings/extensions a deterministic non-input instead of depending on the machine's saved trust decisions or defaultProjectTrust. It does not disable the MCP extension, which is a user/global extension.
